description: This file defines the GeneratorPooledCache class, which implements caching and buffer management for a generator stream provider in Orleans. It manages pooled buffers, serialization, and eviction strategies, and provides methods for adding, retrieving, and purging cached messages.

classes.name: GeneratorPooledCache
classes.description: A pooled cache implementation for Orleans generator stream provider, managing buffer pools, serialization, and eviction strategies.

classes.name: Cursor
classes.description: An internal class implementing IQueueCacheCursor for iterating over cached messages.

methods.name: GetBatchContainer
methods.description: Deserializes a cached message into a batch container.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence token for a cached message.

methods.name: QueueMessageToCachedMessage
methods.description: Converts a generated batch container into a cached message with associated stream position.

methods.name: SerializeMessageIntoPooledSegment
methods.description: Serializes a batch container into a pooled buffer segment, allocating new buffers as needed.

methods.name: GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Creates a StreamPosition object from a batch container.

methods.name: AddToCache
methods.description: Adds a list of batch containers to the cache, converting them into cached messages.

methods.name: TryPurgeFromCache
methods.description: Attempts to purge expired messages from the cache using the eviction strategy.

methods.name: GetCacheCursor
methods.description: Returns a cursor for iterating over messages in a specific stream and token.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Indicates whether the cache is under pressure (e.g., full).
